name: Stompa
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st unit 700 pts for 1 model; 2nd+ unit 800 pts for 1 model.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1 Stompa model. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_transport_note: Printed as: This model has a transport capacity of 22 ORKS INFANTRY models. Each MEGA ARMOUR/JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 models. Each GHAZGHKULL THRAKA model takes up the space of 4 models.
transportCapacity: 22 ORKS INFANTRY models. Each MEGA ARMOUR or JUMP PACK model counts as 2, and each GHAZGHKULL THRAKA model as 4.
_loadout: This model is equipped with: 5 Big Shoota; 1 Deffkannon and Supa-rokkits; 1 Mega-choppa; 1 Skorcha; 1 Supa-gatler.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.
